Create ONE 2D fighting-game CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of Hollowmask (the Grasping Shade), an ORIGINAL character for an original
indie fighting game. It must NOT resemble any existing anime, manga, game or film character.

The FIRST attached image is the approved HOUSE STYLE (another character of this game): copy its rendering exactly - the same
premium high-detail anime fighting-game sprite style, line work, cel shading, metal highlights, proportions, scale and the
same kind of sheet layout - but draw Hollowmask, NOT the character shown there. The SECOND attached image is Hollowmask's portrait:
match the face, hair, colours and costume from it.

THE CHARACTER:
A lean, stooped assassin, tall and narrow with a hunched, gliding carriage and shoulders rolled forward. FACE: a smooth bone-white skull mask with carved flat planes at the brow and cheekbones, a long narrow jaw, two deep black eye sockets with a faint teal glow inside, and one hairline crack running from the left socket down to the jaw. HAIR: none visible; a black cowl covers the crown and falls to the shoulders with ragged, torn edges. COSTUME: a close-fitting charcoal-black bodysuit with dark slate-grey leather straps and bracers, and a black belt. A long ragged near-black cloak with grey-tan tattered hems hangs to the knees and streams behind him. WEAPON: a pair of short, slim, slightly curved bone-white knives, each blade no longer than the hand from wrist to fingertip, on short black wrapped grips with no guard. One knife in each hand, usually reverse-grip with the blade running along the forearm. The RIGHT hand is human and holds the right knife. The LEFT hand is a pale, translucent spectral claw of long fingers that closes around the left knife's grip. His spectral energy, claw glow and trails are MINT-TEAL light with white cores.

ART STYLE: Premium, high-detail anime 2D fighting-game sprite art: the look of a carefully hand-pixelled character sprite rendered at high resolution - crisp deliberate dark outlines (not thick black cartoon lines), cel shading with three to four tones per material, bright specular highlights on metal, a cool rim light, an expressive face with a clear eye, anatomically correct hands with readable fingers, convincing anime anatomy, fluid hair and cloth that follow the motion. Exactly the rendering, palette and level of detail of the attached reference sheet. Not vector art, not blurry, not chibi, no photorealism.

- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right, hunched and slim; a combat stance with both knives reverse-grip; a walking pose; a running pose; a jump; a close-up of the skull mask under the cowl

- bottom row: guard, hit reaction, knocked down, a victory pose, the Phantom Hand special with its mint claw reaching forward
Every figure faces RIGHT (three-quarter side view like the house style), the same scale (standing height about 240 px), feet on
the same ground line within each row.
